limitations: The exact Whittaker–Hill reduction, reciprocal multipliers, and b=1/2 finite-coupling Floquet edge are prior SCOPE coverage and are not claimed as new here. The surviving result is linear and local in the weak-coupling tongue expansion.
provenance: Corrected source-specific spectral consequence of the previously established s=1 Whittaker–Hill reduction. Novelty is limited to the semifinite-gap parity selection rule and the principal anti-periodic tongue asymptotics.
record_title: Semifinite-gap parity selection for the trigonometric Nosé–Hoover central orbit
